name: blood-bank
description: Blood bank management web app built on the MERN stack: inventory, donors, hospitals, blood requests, donation appointments and analytics.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors red,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client

author: Shivam Pandey
